source_hash_provenance: Hashes were recorded at receipt creation from immutable Git blobs. Reader, writer and both test files still byte-matched their reviewed Git blobs; the diff file had already been removed by the concurrent repair agent. This is not an atomic attestation of the entire worktree at test start. Review findings refer to the saved baseline only.

findings.impact: Read-only workspace.diff executes repository-selected clean filter as the host OS user.
findings.reproduction: Commit tracked.txt; add .gitattributes tracked.txt filter=review; configure filter.review.clean to write a marker then cat; modify tracked.txt; call WorkspaceDiff HEAD. Marker was written and API returned nil error.
findings.required_fix: Generate diffs without executing repository filter.clean/filter.process or other repository-selected programs; add negative regression coverage.

findings.impact: Single-file request returns patches for an additional file while reporting total_files=1.
findings.reproduction: Commit and modify a[1].txt and a1.txt; request relative_path a[1].txt. Returned patch and full bytes contain both files.
findings.required_fix: Preserve literal filename selection throughout Git invocation or remove pathspec dependence.

findings.impact: after_hash and actual patch describe different worktree versions.
findings.reproduction: After WorkspaceContent reads snapshot-A, replace actual file with snapshot-B before Git patch generation; returned after_hash is A and patch adds B, without error.
findings.required_fix: Derive hash and patch from one captured byte version; refuse unresolved concurrent snapshot inconsistencies.

findings.impact: Old content/hash is paired with the modification timestamp of a same-size replacement.
findings.reproduction: At the existing post-read context.Err call, rename original and write different same-length bytes with timestamp 2030. Read succeeds with old bytes and new timestamp.
findings.required_fix: Return metadata tied to the same opened file version, or reject replacement based on identity/version validation.

verification.method: Independent reviewer-generated Go test overlay; product source unchanged; all exercised file trees created by t.TempDir.
verification.output_capture: Output transcribed from the already returned tool results; package-summary tabs normalized to spaces. No tests rerun to produce this receipt.
verification.race_injection: Reviewer context.Err implementation uses runtime.Caller to inject one actual os.Rename/os.WriteFile at the existing WorkspaceContent post-read boundary. Deterministic race probe, not a random concurrency benchmark; no production test hook added.

covered: external rename replacement preserves actual replaced bytes, original preimage and candidate
limits: Physical primitive tests only. Domain/client/task/effect integration was still being wired and is not accepted here.
No claim of exhaustive hardlink, same-root alias, crash/power-loss, or all external-editor interleavings coverage.
No end-to-end UI/API acceptance and no W13/W05 production acceptance.
